why: Shrinks the tank to a POINT, which is precisely what every pre-existing check did by reasoning about cell centres. A one-cell gap is 0.667 wide against a 1.0-wide tank and admits no legal centre position, but admits a point trivially -- so under this mutation the minimum-width fixture's 1-cell passage reads as passable and the boards that shipped unplayable read as fine. Pins that the footprint, not the topology, is what the rule measures. RE-ANCHORED after the wall-rasterisation rewrite: the original find string named the per-point wall loop that rewrite replaced, and it went stale without failing anything locally -- CI's failed-to-apply is what said so. KILLED-BY MOVED (issue #425): same reason as `egress-not-gated-only-reported` -- the shipped board it used to be caught on now passes, so this is pinned on the synthetic one-cell-doorway fixture instead, which no board rebuild can take away.
